title: Validate task-sync touched closures through keyed graph and identity projections
outcome: Provide indexed source, destination and immutable-origin closure admission over changed task documents, reusing existing graph rules without reading disconnected tasks.
acceptance: Separate source-before/after, retained-destination and immutable-origin graph views traverse old/new parent, prerequisite and replacement relations in both directions; deletions probe unchanged incoming references, and existing graph validator semantics and refusal precedence are preserved.

Missing reverse replacements, seal-by-work, origin relation and shared identity ownership lookups are rebuildable projections/indexes maintained atomically by existing owners and doctor-checked; no historical canonical bytes, IDs, links or meaning change.

Selected document validation and keyed global identity probes retain note/activity/blocker/short-ref uniqueness and native/run/seal/history/hold refusals without loading disconnected documents or full historical trees. Missing or inconsistent basis/projections refuse explicitly.

Fixtures with at least2000 tasks/history, five edits plus addition/deletion, retained cycles and incoming references, disconnected identities, reverse/no-op cases count actual documents and visited nodes/edges separately; unrelated growth leaves relevant counts unchanged.

Focused checks and required independent review pair pass on exact candidate. Complete READY joins D for ONE all-live-store projection cutover and updates full projection inventory docs; no standalone installation or repair. Ordinary delta atomic apply remains owned by the separate required child.
